title: Southampton FC Deducted Points for Championship Season Start
summary: Southampton Football Club began their Championship season with a four-point deduction. This penalty stems from a 'Spygate' saga. The club lost their first competitive match of the season to Watford.
summary_points: Southampton FC started the Championship season with a four-point deduction.
The deduction is linked to a 'Spygate' incident.
The team lost its opening competitive match against Watford.
